description: Passenger app completion: connect PaymentsScreen to real backend, create TripDetailScreen with ActivityScreen navigation, wrap ActivityTab and AccountTab in stack navigators, create SavedPlacesScreen and EmergencyContactsScreen, add notification deep linking. All independent of driver/admin work.
steps: Create apps/passenger-app/navigation/ActivityStackNavigator.tsx: NativeStack with ActivityList (ActivityScreen) and TripDetail (TripDetailScreen) screens. Import createNativeStackNavigator from @react-navigation/native-stack.
Create apps/passenger-app/navigation/AccountStackNavigator.tsx: NativeStack with AccountMain (AccountScreen), SavedPlaces (SavedPlacesScreen), and EmergencyContacts (EmergencyContactsScreen) screens.
Modify apps/passenger-app/navigation/MainTabNavigator.tsx: replace direct ActivityScreen with ActivityStackNavigator import, replace direct AccountScreen with AccountStackNavigator import.

Create apps/passenger-app/screens/TripDetailScreen.tsx: fetch GET /api/v1/trips/:tripId on mount using AsyncStorage.getItem('@dalasmart:token'), display pickup/dropoff addresses, fare, status badge, driver name+vehicle+plate, date/time, state_log timeline (map state_log entries to labeled steps). Use Ionicons for icons matching existing screen pattern.
Modify apps/passenger-app/screens/ActivityScreen.tsx: add onPress to each trip card calling navigation.navigate('TripDetail', { tripId: trip.id }).

Modify apps/passenger-app/screens/PaymentsScreen.tsx: remove hardcoded paymentMethods and recentTransactions arrays. Add useEffect to fetch GET /api/v1/payments/info (derives phone+provider) and GET /api/v1/payments/history?limit=20. Add 30s polling with setInterval/clearInterval in useEffect cleanup. Add loading state and empty state. Make transaction cards tappable to show inline detail (amount, reference, status, method, date).

Create apps/passenger-app/screens/SavedPlacesScreen.tsx: fetch saved places from backend (GET /api/v1/passengers/places or adapt), list with label+address, add button opens form with label/address text inputs, delete button per item calls DELETE endpoint. Use existing card styling from AccountScreen.
Create apps/passenger-app/screens/EmergencyContactsScreen.tsx: list up to 3 contacts (name+phone), add/edit/remove, PATCH to backend passenger_profiles.emergency_contacts JSONB field.

Modify apps/passenger-app/screens/AccountScreen.tsx: update 'Saved places' menuItem to use screen: 'SavedPlaces' (not 'Settings'), update 'Safety' menuItem to use screen: 'EmergencyContacts' (not 'Settings'). Navigation now works via AccountStackNavigator.

Modify apps/passenger-app/screens/NotificationsScreen.tsx: add onPress to notification items. Read notification.type: 'trip_update'|'trip_completed' → navigation.navigate('ActivityTab'); 'payment' → navigation.navigate('PaymentsTab'); others mark as read only.
acceptance_criteria: ActivityScreen trip cards navigate to TripDetailScreen showing trip data from GET /api/v1/trips/:id
PaymentsScreen shows real transaction history (no hardcoded mock data arrays)
AccountScreen 'Saved places' and 'Safety' menu items navigate to new screens instead of Settings
Notification taps navigate to relevant tabs
cd apps/passenger-app && npx expo export --platform web exits 0
verification: cd /home/masalago/projects/daladala/apps/passenger-app && npx expo export --platform web 2>&1 | tail -20
findings: SavedPlacesScreen and EmergencyContactsScreen: No dedicated REST endpoint exists for passenger saved_places or emergency_contacts (passenger_profiles JSONB columns exist in DB schema but have no routes in api-gateway). Pragmatic fallback: data is persisted locally via AsyncStorage (@dalasmart:saved_places, @dalasmart:emergency_contacts). A future PATCH /api/v1/auth/profile or GET|POST|DELETE /api/v1/passengers/places endpoint should sync these with the backend. PaymentsScreen: GET /api/v1/payments/history endpoint — the route file defines comprehensive payment logic but the /history path may not be registered; if it returns 404 the history section shows the empty state gracefully. Verification: npx expo export --platform web hangs in this environment because node_modules is not installed (npm install fails with 'Invalid Version' due to Expo SDK 51 ~51.0.0 semver range incompatibility with npm v10.9.9 on Node v22). TypeScript logic is verified clean via tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck: the only remaining errors are TS2307 (Cannot find module) from missing node_modules — same as all pre-existing files.
